# norm condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:normCondition`](gmeow-normCondition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/normCondition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The condition under which this norm applies. NOT functional: several conditions on one norm are an implicit conjunction; use a [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) when the combination logic matters.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the condition(s) under which a norm applies.

### Avoid when

- Avoid relying on multiple bare conditions when the combination logic matters (several conditions are an implicit conjunction — use a [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) for any/none/nested trees).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:normCondition`](gmeow-normCondition.md) from the norm to one or more [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) nodes; wrap them in a [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) when you need explicit and/or/not.
